outcome: exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) at two weeks postpartum
exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) at three months postpartum
exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) at six months postpartum
cohort: Mother-newborn dyads with full-term, singleton births and healthy newborns, who delivered between mid-March and December 2020.
finding: The prevalence of breastfeeding initiation and exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) in the first six months postpartum was low among Saudi mothers during the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic, with EBF associated with birth weight, hospital breastfeeding, early initiation of breastfeeding, parity, and method of delivery.
mod_finding: Exclusive breastfeeding at six months was associated with the method of delivery.
